exposure: Number of pelvic examinations before delivery
pelvic examination before delivery on ≥5 occasions
outcome: Types of SSI: incisional vs. organ/space
finding: Several factors, including a wound class ≥3, ethnic minority status, low hemoglobin, multiple pelvic examinations, preterm delivery, being a local referral, and foul-smelling amniotic fluid, were identified as risk factors for cesarean organ-space SSIs.
